subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
An angle modulated signal is given by 
 
s(t) = cos2𝜋[2 × 106t + 30 sin 150t + 40 cos 150t] 
 
The maximum frequency and phase deviations of s(t) 
are 
 
(a) 10.5 kHz, 140𝜋 rad 
 
(b) 6 kHz, 80𝜋 rad 
 
(c) 10.5 kHz, 100𝜋 rad 
 
(c) 7.5 kHz, 100𝜋 rad
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-02 (Analog Communication - AM & FM).
